name: Hurezi Monastery
description: Hurezi Monastery sits in the town of Horezu in Wallachia, southern Romania. Prince Constantin Brâncoveanu founded it in 1690, and it is regarded as the finest example of the Brâncovenesc style, admired for its balanced architecture and finely carved stonework. Inside, look for the painted religious scenes and portraits of donors. In the 18th century its painting school became famous across the Balkans.
